bangumi.summary:
Few people know the truth, but Marsupilamis are real!

Hope, Twister and Punch, three young Marsupilamis, remain together today, each one bursting with energy and a personality as wild as the world around them!

They have found a home with Jade and Mica, a pair of nine-year-old twins with generous hearts and imaginations that never rest. Keeping their presence hidden is far from simple, especially when these playful and furry creatures have a talent for stumbling into the most unexpected and hilarious situations.
bangumi.name: The Marsupilamis
